title: Nether Scythe DataPack
description: This Data Pack Adds A Scythe That Can Shoot At Mobs And Let You Fly Around In Spectator Mode For A Few Seconds.
body:
- This Data Pack Adds A Scythe That Can Shoot At Mobs And Let You Fly Around In Spectator Mode For A Few Seconds

To Craft The Nether Scythe You Will Need, Two Obsidian, One Crying Obsidian, And Three Netherite Scraps.

**To Use The Scythe Just Press F With It, And To Fly Around For A Little Bit Just Sneak And Press F**

Functions:
